summary: Tested the iteration-6 changes. Backend: 33/33 pass. That is 7 new tests in test_iter6_portraits_landing.py plus the character-look and phase-1 regression suites. /cosmetics/avatar and /cosmetics/buy-avatar return 410 and leave the look unchanged. GET /api/players/{username} returns look:* and avatar_name null; a legacy 'av_lad' user maps to look:m_1_1. Leaderboards return only look:* avatars. Landing desktop (1920): every section renders (ticker scrolling, online/players, wiki, login, image logo, tagline, no-p2w, trailer, mascots, board, 6 shots, facts, 3 news cards with loaded images, 7 feature cards, guides, footer) with no broken images. The shot viewer opens from the trailer and all 6 shots; prev/next and backdrop close work. Login with TestAngler goes to /game. Register with a new TEST_ user goes to /game. Landing mobile (390): no horizontal scroll, sections stack, the login popover fits. Game HUD: all 6 menu-* buttons are fr-tile with tile_frame.webp, painted icons (map.png, face_f_2_3.webp for My Angler) and red ribbon labels. Hover lifts by 4px. All open their pages (waters, journal, inventory, shop, profile, more-modal). The cast button is a rounded square (18px radius); SAIL opens /game/waters. Signposts are square tile frames. Tapping Tackle Shop auto-opened /game/shop. Tapping Pearl Shop is STILL STUCK. Profile (mobile 390): no legacy button, no portrait name. look-dialog is portalled to body and centred; Save is visible at y=542 and saving works (TestAngler2 was restored to m_3_2). Fishing regression: walking to fish-1, casting and the fight panel all work. No JS page errors.

minor.issue: Flaky only when run after the other suites in one sequential session (2 presence tests see no peers). They pass alone and under xdist. This is test-ordering or presence-TTL state, not an app bug.

ui_bugs.issue: Pearl Shop signpost (dest 1464,637) still never auto-opens. Sampled __fx.me every 500ms: the hero ping-pongs between x=1459.5 and x=1471.0 forever, with dest and autoOpen still set and moving=true. RCA: the step size (230*dt, about 11.5px at low FPS) is larger than twice the d<4 arrival threshold, so the hero overshoots every frame. The new no-progress check (moved <0.5) never triggers because the hero does move. Tackle Shop only worked by chance. Fix: clamp the step to the remaining distance, e.g. `const step = Math.min(230*dt, d)`, or snap me to dest when d <= step, then fire autoOpen.

ui_bugs.component: Game HUD action bar on mobile 390x844
ui_bugs.issue: The tile bar is about 450px wide on a 390px viewport. menu-waters spans x=-29..32 (the 'Travel Map' label is clipped to 'l map') and menu-more spans 379..419 (half off-screen). Reduce the tile size and gaps under the sm breakpoint, or let the bar scroll or wrap.

The viewer is rendered inside a z-10 section, so the catch ticker and top bar (z-20) draw above the dark overlay. Clicking the top strip hits the ticker, not the backdrop, so the viewer does not close there. Also, the has no key, so the previous large image stays visible until the new full-size jpg (200-360KB) loads; we saw caption 'Climb the weekly…' over the willow image. Fix: createPortal to body and add key={open} to the img (or show a thumbnail first).

Make the HUD tile bar fit 390px phones (smaller tiles or gaps on mobile, or a scrollable bar); Travel Map and More are clipped now
Portal lp-shot-viewer to document.body and key the img by index to avoid the stale image and the ticker drawing over the overlay
Optional: move the harbour hint pill so it does not cover the Tournaments signpost; give the More-menu entries unique icons
critical_code_review_comments: cosmetics.py set_avatar/buy_avatar: dead code after `raise HTTPException(410)`. Remove it, along with AvatarIn/owned_avatars if unused
Scene.js L421: the no-progress check compares movement per frame, which cannot detect oscillation. A step clamp is the robust fix
Landing.js CatchTicker maps species_id % 10 to 10 hard-coded fish images, so ticker fish art does not match the named species
Landing.js Hero: useState(() => [...]) for a constant look array; the destructured `look` is a constant, so a plain const is enough
seed_data_creation: Registered TEST_110767x via the landing UI. The pytest legacy-user test creates a TEST_ user and deletes it. TestAngler2's look was changed to m_3_4 and restored to look:m_3_2.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Profile endpoint is GET /api/players/{username} (not /profile). Run pytest with -n 0 for sequential runs (pytest.ini uses xdist); clear db.rate_events {action:'signup'} if register returns 429. To reproduce the Pearl Shop stuck walk: log in as TestAngler at 1920x1080 on /game, click the screen at (636,716), then poll __fx.me.x; it oscillates around 1464. Mobile HUD clipping: check the bounding rects of menu-waters and menu-more at 390px.
rca of the issue: Signpost stuck: the per-frame step is 230*dt. At about 20fps that is about 11.5px, larger than the 8px window of the d<4 arrival test, so the hero alternates sides of dest. The 'moved < 0.5px' fallback never fires because it does move each frame. Mitigation: step = Math.min(230*dt, d), or snap to dest when d <= step.
